healthy.name: Healthy Baseline Operation
healthy.symptom: Normal baseline vibration (RMS < 4.5 mm/s), low kurtosis (~3.0 Gaussian), nominal winding temperature and current draw.
healthy.cause: Mechanical assembly, lubrication, and dynamic balance are within standard engineering tolerances.
healthy.recommended_action: Continue routine condition monitoring. Maintain standard periodic lubrication and vibration logging intervals.

unbalance.name: Rotor Dynamic Unbalance
unbalance.symptom: Predominant 1X running frequency vibration component (peak_1x >= 3.8 mm/s, ratio 1X/2X >= 1.8), radial direction dominant.
unbalance.cause: Uneven mass distribution on the rotor shaft due to dirt buildup on cooling fan, material erosion, or missing balancing weights.
unbalance.recommended_action: Perform dynamic single/two-plane field balancing using a strobe/tachometer. Inspect rotor fan for dirt buildup or damaged blades.

misalignment.name: Shaft / Coupling Misalignment
misalignment.symptom: Dominant 2X rotational speed harmonic (peak_2x >= 2.8 mm/s, ratio 2X/1X >= 0.8), elevated axial vibration, coupling temperature rise.
misalignment.cause: Thermal expansion mismatch, soft-foot condition, improper base shimming during installation, or pipe strain pulling the pump casing.
misalignment.recommended_action: Check soft-foot tolerance (< 0.05 mm) using feeler gauges. Perform precision laser shaft alignment on motor-to-pump coupling.

bearing_wear.name: Rolling Element Bearing Defect
bearing_wear.symptom: Elevated Kurtosis (> 3.8 indicates impulsive shock impacts from spalls), bearing housing temperature rise (> 70 °C), high-frequency harmonics.
bearing_wear.cause: L10 fatigue spalling on race raceways, insufficient or contaminated grease, mechanical over-tightening, or fluting from VFD PWM voltages.
bearing_wear.recommended_action: Inspect grease condition for metal flakes and degradation. Schedule bearing replacement during next maintenance window; increase monitoring frequency.

overload_jam.name: Mechanical Overload / Impeller Jam
overload_jam.symptom: Motor current exceeds 115% of rated current, rotor RPM drops below rated slip, rapid winding temperature rise, elevated overall RMS.
overload_jam.cause: Debris lodged in pump impeller or driven load, excessive slurry viscosity, high discharge head pressure, or mechanical binding in gearbox.
overload_jam.recommended_action: Immediately de-energize motor (Lockout/Tagout). Inspect pump suction strainer and casing for foreign debris. Manually verify free rotor shaft rotation.

rules.description: 2X harmonic indicates angular or parallel misalignment
2X harmonic amplitude is at least 80% of 1X
Impulsive impact kurtosis indicates bearing surface spalling
Stator current exceeds 115% of rated full-load current
Excessive motor slip / speed drop under heavy mechanical load
ISO 10816 Zone D critical vibration limit
